messages:
tara-cs: Mosaic Labs onboarding: they want a live demo from Brazil on 2025-07-10 and asked for a short-lived capacity bump + CIDR allowlist and a one-off API key rotation after the demo. They also said the renewal exec will watch the demo, so we need zero surprises. Can we provision 250 QPS (currently 40) for 48h starting 2025-07-10T16:00:00Z? CIDRs: `187.45.90.0/24`, `187.45.91.0/24`. /cc @devin-netops @sam-eng

devin-netops: Hosted or Dedicated? Any client certs/mTLS? Will traffic be pinned to sa-east-1 for the window?

tara-cs: Hosted. No mTLS. Yes, pin to `sa-east-1` during the window. Auto-revoke key 2025-07-12T16:05:00Z. Also want the ephemeral key scope-limited to demo-only.

devin-netops: Got it. Opening infra ticket and will schedule apply + smoke tests. Plan outline:
```
- add ACL entries 187.45.90.0/24, 187.45.91.0/24 to br-edge-peers
- create customer:mosaic override -> 250 QPS window 48h
- create ephemeral key set: mosaic-demo-20250710, TTL 50h, auto-revoke at 2025-07-12T16:05:00Z
- schedule apply at 2025-07-10T15:45:00Z for smoke tests and perf validation
```
I'll post infra ticket and smoke logs.

riley-support: I'll prepare the demo runbook, share the ephemeral key securely with Mosaic SRE, and capture enablement feedback immediately after the demo. Suggest a 15-min pre-demo check with their SRE at 2025-07-10T15:30:00Z.

ops-bot: Reminder created: `revoke-keys-mosaic-20250712` at 2025-07-12T16:05:00Z :white_check_mark:

sam-eng: Please paste the infra ticket link and any perf/latency notes so CS can set expectations for the execs. Any model fallback plans?

devin-netops: infra-12890 -> https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/12890. Expect minimal tail-latency change (<7ms) at edge under 250 QPS; no model swapping or quantization changes required. Will attach smoke output after apply.

tara-cs: Thanks all 44d I'll coordinate pre-demo call and make sure the exec invite is covered. Will collect feedback during the demo and flag any renewal cues.

riley-support: Also logging a quick checklist for post-demo feedback capture: 1) demo stability 2) latency vs expectations 3) ease of key handoff 4) any network glints — will post a short feedback note thread.

devin-netops: Apply scheduled. Will ping here when rollout completes and include logs.

tara-cs: Great 44f rolling communications now.
